findings.message: the reactivity contract for solid-js has no entrypoint/export summary for imported export createStore; solid-checker cannot tell whether it reads reactive values, takes tracked callbacks, or returns accessors, so code flowing through it cannot be certified
findings.hint: Add an export summary for createStore to the package's solid-reactivity.json (reactive reads, callbacks, return kind); an empty summary certifies explicitly that the export is not reactive. See docs/package-contracts.md for the format.
